postings.title: Full-Stack Developer, Music & Audio
postings.description:
WHO WE ARE

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

As one of our first developers, you will bridge the gap between beautifully designed frontends and scalable backends. You'll tackle the big questions: How do we build systems that scale while maintaining simplicity? What’s the fastest way to ship the right amount of function? And how do we leverage AI in every part of our process? Working fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, your answers to these questions will directly influence our company's success. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 - Owning features across our full stack, writing clean code for both frontend and backend systems

 - Working directly with commercial teams to architect and implement platform enhancements

 - Using AI coding assistants and modern development tools to accelerate workflows and maintain code quality

 - Building robust APIs and integrating AI models into production systems

 - Designing end-to-end solutions that combine individual data flows into unified models across verticals

 - Thinking of creative ideas and making bold decisions that shape our technology platform

 


WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for creative, ambitious and skilled full-stack engineers who can drive our business with technical solutions. You're someone who doesn't just write code, you translate ideas into software that is easy yet powerful, leveraging AI-enhanced workflows to deliver production-ready MVPs at lightspeed. Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - Degree in CS or related field with 2+ years of full-time full-stack development experience

 - Proficient in core programming languages with hands-on experience in modern web frameworks (preferably Node.js/Next.js) and databases

 - Expert with AI coding tools and development agents as part of your standard workflow

 - Experience building and deploying production-ready full-stack applications

 - Strong collaboration skills across commercial, product, and technical teams

 - Always on the forefront of adopting the latest development technologies

 - You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 - Colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent

 - You’re obsessed with music, video or social media

 


WHAT MAKES THIS EXCITING

You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 


WHAT THE PROCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

 1. Online assessment: Motivational questionnaire and aptitude test - are you made for the job?

 2. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

 3. Take-home case study: Real-world project - showcase your skills and working style

 4. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your results with a team member

 5. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

 6. Team interview: Individual or group interview with other team members - depending on position

 7. Offer, contract signing and onboarding


Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Join us as our first dedicated Data Scientist to bring order to the chaos of culture. You'll turn raw, messy data into insights to tackle the big questions: What is changing in how people find and enjoy media? Why do some bets work and others not? And where is our next opportunity? We sit on a lot of data we do not use yet, and you are the person who turns it into decisions. You work fully autonomously alongside our founder and the team, next to a backend engineer who owns the pipelines and infrastructure, so your time goes into the questions rather than the plumbing. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 - New data sources: finding and opening up new sources that help us make better decisions

 - Trends and audiences: analyzing trends, audience behavior and performance to find the next growth opportunity, and proposing the next step

 - Prediction: prototyping and deploying ML models on AWS for forecasting and content analysis, and checking whether they hold up in production

 - Experiments: designing and reading A/B tests, holdouts and spend experiments across our products and campaigns, and telling the team where the next dollar should go

 - Numbers people trust: owning the dashboards and reports leadership runs on, and investigating what really drives a metric when it moves

 - AI-native workflows: using LLMs and agentic coding tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis and reporting

 

Who you are

We look for battle-tested data scientists who understand that real impact comes from turning messy, unstructured data into business-critical insights that drive company direction. You don't just build models: you solve business problems and translate statistical findings into actions the team takes.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - Background: a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Math or a related quantitative field

 - Experience: 3 or more years of hands-on data science in fast-paced business environments, at Tier 1 consultancies, Big Tech, high-growth start-ups and scale-ups, or media industry leaders

 - Python: expert-level proficiency with the standard data science and ML frameworks, and SQL as a daily tool

 - Data acquisition: you have brought new raw data sources into use and made them reliable enough to decide on

 - Statistical rigour: you design and read experiments properly, you know when a signal is noise, and you have run A/B tests or causal analyses that changed a decision

 - Models in production: you have deployed models that people actually used, and you know what it takes to keep them honest over time

 - AI-native: extensive hands-on experience with agentic coding tools and LLMs in your data workflows

 - From data to decision: you find the opportunity in the data and propose the next step, and your dashboards and visualizations (standard libraries or Tableau) are the ones leadership trusts

 - Collaboration: you work well across engineering, product and business teams, and colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent

 - Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 - A big plus: you're obsessed with music, video or social media

 

What makes this exciting

You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

 1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

 2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

 3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

 4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

 - Defining and shipping v1 of a new consumer product from scratch, prototyping fast and cutting anything that doesn't earn its place

 - Owning the product end to end, from user research to shipped features, across the full stack of the experience

 - Living in the numbers: retention, DAU and the engagement loops that shape our trajectory

 - Running user interviews constantly and turning what you hear into product people love

 - Building with AI as a default primitive, not a bolt-on, using modern tools to go from idea to production-ready MVP at lightspeed

 - Making bold product calls and creative bets that shape our roadmap and our company

 


WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for a builder who happens to be a product person, or a product person who can build. You've shipped consumer product that real people used and came back to, and you know exactly why they did.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - 3 or more years of experience, with real time as an engineer or working shoulder to shoulder with engineering

 - You've built and launched a B2C product at genuine engagement, ideally in music, media or streaming, though any high-engagement consumer product counts

 - You understand what locks users in: retention, engagement loops, habit formation

 - Equal parts user-obsessed and numbers-driven. You run the interviews and you decide off the data, and you need both

 - AI-native, with AI woven through how you research, design and build

 - You come from an early-stage, high-growth consumer company, or you started one yourself. You think like a founder because you have been early before

 - You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 - You're obsessed with music, video or social media

postings.title: Growth Manager
postings.description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Melotech is scaling fast. As Growth Manager, you own our paid growth end to end: the budget, the channels, the creative testing and the numbers behind them. You decide where the budget goes, and you work directly with our founders, product and data team.

Your first job is to bring structure to our paid social account: decide what to consolidate and what to split, separate testing from scaling, and segment by geography, age and placement so every number means something.

 

We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 - Account structure: deciding what to consolidate and what to split, keeping testing and scaling apart, and segmenting ad sets by geography, age and placement

 - Campaign operations: running the campaigns day to day on Meta, TikTok and Snapchat, including budgets, pacing and the targets behind them

 - Creative pipeline: building a system that keeps new creatives flowing every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and briefs that turn last week's numbers into next week's ads

 - Creative partners: directing editors, video producers, UGC creators and agencies to the volume and quality the account needs

 - Budget allocation: moving budget across campaigns on data, weighing upside against risk

 - Measurement: knowing which metric answers which question, for example what CPM tells you that CPC does not, and catching a shift in cost the day it happens

 - Tooling: building the reports, scripts and automations you need, with the ad platform APIs and AI tools as your daily coworkers

 

Who you are

We're looking for a hands-on paid operator, or a sharp growth generalist who has done the buying. Either way, you have run real budgets yourself, not through a team or an agency, and you can show the numbers.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - Experience: 2 to 7 years of hands-on paid buying, ideally in a startup or small team where you set things up yourself

 - Paid social channel ownership: you have owned Meta, TikTok or Snapchat end to end, ideally more than one of them and more than once, and you have run accounts at real volume, so you can explain how you structured a large account without losing control of it

 - Creative testing at scale: you test on a schedule with kill rules, direct creative partners instead of making the ads, and notice when a hook or format is burning out; ideally you bring a network of trusted editors, creators and agencies

 - Budget decisions: you are comfortable allocating a budget across many tests and making structured decisions under uncertainty

 - Measurement: you check what platforms report against your own data, you have run holdout or lift tests, and you know which metric answers which question, for example what CPM tells you that CPC does not

 - Data and tooling: you work in SQL or Python, have used the ad platform APIs, and build your own reporting and automations; a data science background is a plus

 - Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 - A big plus: you stay close to what works in paid social right now, and you're into music, media, gaming or social

 

What makes this exciting

You own a lever the whole company feels, and your work shows up directly in how fast we can grow. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

 

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

 1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

 2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

 3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

 4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

 

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

postings.title: Backend Engineer
postings.description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, Melotech has raised more than $16M from Drive Capital and Europe’s leading VCs: Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and Global Founders Capital, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

 

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer for Data and Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

 - Data collection: keeping our external data integrations reliable as sources and APIs change

 - Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

 - Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

 - Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

 - Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

 - Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

 - Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

 

Who you are

We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

 - Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team

 - Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends

 - External data: you have kept third party data integrations reliable in production, and you know how to handle rate limits, retries and changes without notice

 - Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run

 - Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against

 - Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management

 - Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team

 - Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build

 - Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

 

What makes this exciting

Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.
